references.text: A similar miracle where Moses and the Israelites receive manna from heaven in the wilderness demonstrates God's ability to provide food for His people under impossible circumstances
Jesus feeds five thousand men, plus women and children, with five loaves of bread and two fish, an earlier miracle showing his power over nature and ability to provide
In Mark, Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves of bread and two fish, parallel to Matthew's account of a similar miracle
In Luke, Jesus feeds five thousand men with five loaves of bread and two fish, another parallel account
John's version of the miracle where Jesus feeds five thousand emphasizes Jesus' ability to meet human needs
